title: Colsdown1.1.0 — The poster is the layout
prompt:
Edit the second image: finalize this same Colsdown 4:3 broadside poster, preserving its expressive asymmetric layout, giant Colsdown wordmark and orange 1.1.0 upper-right notch. The first image is the original brand reference only.

Make these exact corrections:
1. All SIX benefit phrases must use the SAME bold font size and weight as the current "Save a preset", including "Nest your layouts". Reduce "Nest your layouts" to match. Preserve readable exact wording for all six: "Drag to resize", "Nest your layouts", "Edit in place", "Move with arrow keys", "Save a preset", "Use it again". Line breaks may vary but not font size.
2. Strictly SOLID flat fills throughout. Remove ALL gradients, grain, glow and shadow. Only these precise solid colors: cream #f4f0e7, aubergine #241a35, purple #7853ce, lavender #c9b8ef, lime #d5e8a5, orange #ff9b68.
3. Remove every decorative fake text bar and remove the two fake content cards within the purple center. Instead give the purple center a single large flat lavender inset containing "Nest your layouts" in aubergine, so the words themselves are nested. Keep enough purple visible around the lavender to demonstrate nesting.
4. Keep exactly one small round resize handle at the left gutter, exactly one insertion caret beside "Edit in place", and exactly one simple right-angle arrow path beside "Move with arrow keys". Avoid other icons and redundant symbols.
5. Preserve large exact title "Colsdown", readable exact subtitle "Columns & stacks for Obsidian", exact version "1.1.0". No additional text.

A finished crisp typographic geometric editorial poster with intentional empty space; different-width regions, no equal-card grid. Upright typography, sharp shapes, opaque background. Exact legible lettering. No texture, fake app chrome, watermark, gradients or shadows.
description: User-approved modular poster with the six plugin benefits integrated into its column geometry.
